meta.og_title: Ragon — saurin rubuta lambar AI a kan teburinka.
meta.og_description: Wakilin rubuta lamba, mataimakin tattaunawa da manhajar desktop, duk suna aiki gaba ɗaya a kan GB10 ɗinka. Babu cloud. Babu asusu. Babu kuɗin API. Babu telemetry.
install.h101: Rubuta lambar AI cikin sauri a kan teburinka.
install.p02: Wakilin rubuta lamba, mataimakin tattaunawa da manhajar desktop, duk suna aiki gaba ɗaya a kan GB10 ɗinka. Babu cloud. Babu asusu. Babu kuɗin API. Babu telemetry.
install.span04: # yana sauke samfurin sau ɗaya (~20 GB), sannan ya fara bayar da shi
install.p06: Yana aiki a kan NVIDIA DGX Spark da kowace na'urar GB10. Script ɗin yana tabbatar da kowane saukewa da checksums na fitowar, kuma yana nuna kowane umarnin sudo kafin ya gudanar da shi. Karanta shi tukuna idan kana so.
install.p08: Sauran kwamfutocinka suna amfani da samfurin GB10 ta hanyar cibiyar sadarwa ta gida. A kan Mac ko wata na'urar Linux, umarnin da ke sama iri ɗaya yana shigar da client ɗin ragon; yana gano GB10 da kansa.
install.p12: A cikin PowerShell. Yana shigarwa ba tare da haƙƙin mai gudanarwa ba, sannan Windows ta tambaya sau ɗaya don kafa sandbox ɗin wakilin. Ba a sa hannu a kai ba tukuna, don haka dole a kashe Smart App Control. Karanta script ɗin.
install.span15: haɗin phone-home, egress audit ya tabbatar
new.h201: Manhajar desktop a kan Mac, Linux da Windows
new.p02: Manhajar desktop ta Ragon tana haɗa Ask da Work a taga ɗaya. Work cikakken wurin aiki ne na zaman wakili: composer mai fayiloli, skills da umarni, allon review don stage, mayarwa da commit, worktrees, shafukan terminal, da itacen fayiloli da shafukan fayiloli kusa da thread. A sauran kwamfutocinka client ne na GB10 ɗinka, wanda yake ganowa a cibiyar sadarwa ta gida.
new.p04: Umarnin shigarwa yana sanya Ragon a Applications kusa da ragon, kuma yana buɗewa kamar kowace manhaja. Apple silicon da Intel, macOS 12 ko sama. ragon update yana sabunta shi.
new.p06: A kan GB10, ragon_<version>_arm64.deb yana shigar da manhajar, mazauninta a menu na farawa da umarnin ragon-app, tare da tsarin sandbox profile da take buƙata:
new.p07: Sannan ka buɗe ta daga menu na manhajoji, ko da ragon app. Ƙari.
new.p09: Layin PowerShell yana shigar da manhajar ita ma, don kai kaɗai kuma ba tare da haƙƙin mai gudanarwa ba, da shigarwa a menu na Start; Settings → Apps yana cire ta; ragon update yana sabunta ta. Dole a kashe Smart App Control.
new.p11: Shafin fitowa yana kuma ɗauke da dmg na Mac (Ragon-<version>-arm64-preview.dmg, ko x64 don Intel) da na'urar shigarwa ta Windows (Ragon-Setup-<version>-x64.exe, ko arm64). Samfoti ne marasa sa hannu: idan an sauke su da browser, ana hana su a karon farko. Duba kowanne da SHA256SUMS mai sa hannu na fitowar tukuna.
new.li12: macOS 15 da sama: ja Ragon zuwa Applications ka buɗe shi sau ɗaya, sannan System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway. A macOS 14 da ƙasa, Control-danna manhajar › Open.
new.li13: Windows: SmartScreen › More info › Run anyway. Dole a kashe Smart App Control.
try.p02: Ko kuma ka jera aiki don daren yau da /night add <task>: Ragon yana aiki a kan jerin yayin da kake barci, kowane aiki a git branch ɗinsa, kai kuma kana duba branches ɗin da kofi a hannu.
proof.h201: Lambarka ba ta barin teburinka — kuma za ka iya tabbatarwa
proof.p02: Wakilan rubuta lamba na cloud suna aika lambar tushenka zuwa sabar wasu. Ragon ba ya aika ta ko'ina: samfurin yana aiki a GB10 ɗinka, kuma babu abin da ke cikin Ragon da ke tuntuɓar waje. Babu nazarin amfani, babu metrics, babu shiga da asusu, babu rahotannin tsayawar manhaja (crash reports) na "ɓoyayyen suna". Wannan yana sa a iya amfani da shi ga lambar da ba a yarda ka ɗora ba: aikin abokin ciniki, bayanan da doka ke sarrafawa, kayayyakin da ba a fitar ba.
proof.p03: Umarni ɗaya yana gudanar da zaman Ragon na gaske a ƙarƙashin strace yana jera kowane haɗin cibiyar sadarwa da ya yi:
proof.p04: Komai ya tsaya a 127.0.0.1. Ko neman DNS ɗaya babu.
proof.p06: Rubuta /airgapped on kuma kowane umarnin da wakili ke gudanarwa yana samun network namespace maras komai daga kernel na Linux. Ba roƙo ne na ladabi ga samfurin ba: kawai babu cibiyar sadarwa da za a kai. Full Access, wanda zai tsallake sandbox, ana ƙi shi a lokaci guda.
proof.h307: Me zai iya fita, kuma yaushe
proof.p08: Abin da kai ko wakili kuka nema kawai: binciken gidan yanar gizo (ta hanyar SearXNG na sirri a na'urarka), ɗaukar shafi, buƙatar karantawa kawai ga asusun Google da ka haɗa, ko duba sabuntawa. A /airgapped on, babu ko ɗaya daga cikinsu.
why.p03: Samfurin, lambarka, buƙatunka da amsoshinka suna zama a na'urar da suke ciki.
why.li05: Egress audit da za ka iya sake gudanarwa
why.li16: Babu tuning: an zaɓi samfuri, mahallin rubutu, kernels da speculative decoding don GB10.
why.li17: Ba zai tsayar da na'urarka cak ba: ana duba na'urar (host) kuma ana sa ido kan matsin memory yayin lodawa.
why.li18: Sauran na'urorinka suna samunsa a cibiyar sadarwa ta gida.
features.p03: Yana karanta repository ɗinka, yana gudanar da umarni da gwaje-gwaje, yana gyara lamba, kuma yana tambaya kafin duk wani abu mai haɗari.
features.p05: /night add <task> kafin barci; kowane aiki a git branch ɗinsa zuwa safiya. Babu abin da ake haɗawa (merge) ko turawa (push) ba tare da kai ba.
features.h306: 🔎 Binciken yanar gizo da ɗaukar shafi
features.p07: Ta hanyar SearXNG na sirri a na'urarka: babu asusun bincike, babu API key.
features.p09: Ma'anoni, masu kira da tasiri a duk repository ɗinka, don wakili ya sami lambar maimakon neman ta da grep.
features.h310: 🧩 Skills ɗinka da kake da su
features.p11: Skills da ka rubuta wa Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw ko Hermes suna aiki ba tare da canji ba.
features.p13: Tambayoyi tare da binciken yanar gizo, binciken hotuna da yin rubutu da murya, da zaman wakilanka, daga wannan na'ura ko wayar da aka haɗa, a kan samfurin gida iri ɗaya.
features.p15: Ask da Work a taga ɗaya, a kan GB10, Mac, Linux ko Windows: zaman wakili da amincewa, allon review, worktrees da soke aiki.
features.p17: Karantawa kawai, ta hanyar shiga da ke zama a na'urarka. A kashe gaba ɗaya a /airgapped on.
compare.h201: Ragon da wakilan rubuta lamba na cloud
compare.td15: Yana aiki idan an cire cibiyar sadarwa
compare.td18: Za ka iya tabbatar da abin da ke fita
machines.p02: Suna raba chip ɗaya, unified memory na 128 GB da DGX OS 7, don haka na'urar shigarwa ɗaya tana rufe su duka. Ana haɓaka Ragon kuma a gwada shi kullum a ASUS Ascent GX10; gwaje-gwaje suna rufe sauran.
faq.p03: Eh, don gudanar da samfurin. Sauran kwamfutocinka suna amfani da shi a matsayin clients: Linux (Arm ko x86) da macOS da umarnin shigarwa iri ɗaya, Windows (Arm ko x86, samfoti) da layin PowerShell.
faq.p07: Eh. Ragon buɗaɗɗen tushe ne a ƙarƙashin AGPL, kuma weights ɗin samfurin kyauta ne. Abin da kake kashewa kawai shi ne wutar lantarki.
faq.summary08: Me nake buƙata baya ga na'urar?
faq.p09: Tsarin aiki da take zuwa da shi (DGX OS 7, ko Ubuntu 24.04 inda mai samarwa ke bayarwa), Docker tare da NVIDIA Container Toolkit, Python 3 da Git. A Ubuntu na yau da kullum, ragon-admin host check yana gaya maka abin da babu.
faq.summary10: Shin wani abu yana kai intanet?
faq.p11: Abin da kai ko wakili kuka nema kawai, kamar binciken yanar gizo ta SearXNG a na'urarka, da saukewa na farko. /airgapped on yana kashe duka.
faq.p13: Qwen3.8-27B a tsarin NVFP4 na 4-bit na NVIDIA, injinmu ragon-serve ke bayarwa tare da drafter na DFlash2 (SGLang ya kasance madadin a duk tsawon 0.9.x), an zaɓa kuma an daidaita shi don GB10. Weights kusan 20 GB; kusan 38 GB na memory ɗin na'urar yana ragewa a fili yayin da yake aiki.
cta.h201: Ka riƙe lambarka a kan teburinka
cta.p02: Idan ka yi imanin lamba ya kamata ta zauna a teburin da aka rubuta ta, ka yi wa repository tauraro: haka sauran masu GB10 ke gano Ragon.
footer.p01: Ragon daga Dreamference. Dreamference tana gina AI na sirri da ke aiki a kan kayan aikinka.
footer.p02: Buɗaɗɗen tushe a ƙarƙashin GNU AGPL v3. NVIDIA, GB10, DGX da DGX Spark alamun kasuwanci ne na NVIDIA Corporation; sauran sunaye alamun kasuwanci ne na masu su. Ragon da Dreamference ba su da alaƙa da su.
footer.p03: Wannan shafin ba ya yin buƙatu ga wani ɓangare na uku: babu masu bin diddigi, babu nazari, babu fonts na waje.
mock.s4: Rufe hanyoyin host a cikin bwrap
mock.user: Gwaje-gwajen rajista suna kasa idan aka bar adireshin imel fanko. Nemo dalilin kuma ka gyara.
mock.agent: Kalmomin da ke ɗauke da sarari kawai sun tsallake binciken kafin daidaitawa. An cire sararin farko a src/auth/signup.py kuma an ƙara gwajin tabbatarwa.
new.c1_h3: Injin ragon-serve, ScaleSearch drafter, da Forgejo a kowane node
new.c1_p: ragon-serve yana gudanar da Qwen3.8-27B a kan GB10 da mahallin 262K, kowane node yana samun Forgejo mai zaman kansa, kuma Telegram Mini App yana aiki kai tsaye a kan ma'adananka.
new.c2_h3: An rufe sockets na host, fihirisar fayiloli na cikin gida, da LoRA adapters
new.c2_p: Yana rufe sockets na Docker, containerd, D-Bus da systemd a cikin akwatin tsaro, yana ƙara OCR da takardun ofis zuwa ragon-docs, kuma yana ba da LoRA adapters masu sa hannu.
new.c3_h3: Manhajar tebur a macOS, Linux da Windows, da Night Shift best-of-N
new.c3_p: Ask da Work suna raba taga ɗaya mai ɗauke da sashin dubawa, worktrees da shafukan terminal; /night add --best-of N yana gwada aiki sau N kuma ya zaɓi mafi kyau.
surfaces.r3_p: Haɗa JetBrains ko VS Code ta stdio MCP (ragon-admin mcp), ko aika saƙo zuwa GB10 ɗinka daga Signal (Note to Self), Telegram (tare da Mini App) da Matrix ta Tailscale. Kowace hanyar waya tana kashe har sai ka kunna ta.
